title.suggested: Allen Signs Articles for Bauer in Wrestling Match With Schroeder

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that Tom Allen acted for Prof. Bauer at Tony Faust's, putting up the rest of the stakes and signing articles for Bauer's $500-a-side wrestling match with Julius Schroeder at the Temple.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Friday Morning, May 5, 1876, page 6. Meeting was 'yesterday afternoon' (May 4). Current title is wrong: Leon Schuler was the stakeholder, Allen was Bauer's representative.

facts.fact: Allen represented wrestler Prof. Bauer at Tony Faust's, depositing the remaining stakes and signing articles for Bauer's $500-a-side match with Julius Schroeder, set for May 6 at the Temple
